description: This PHP source file defines a controller class 'MyTimesheetController' within an HRM system plugin. The class handles rendering a timesheet component, initializes default timesheets if they do not exist, and interacts with related services and models such as 'Timesheet'. It utilizes traits for authentication, date/time helpers, and timesheet services, and extends a base Vue controller.

classes.name: MyTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller managing the user's timesheet view and logic, including default timesheet creation if none exists and component rendering for front-end display.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the timesheet component for rendering; initializes default timesheet if absent and adds startDate property if provided in request.

methods.name: createDefaultTimesheetIfNotExist
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for the current user and date; creates a new one if absent.
